name: South Carolina

agency.name: South Carolina Department of Environmental Services (SCDES)
agency.division: Bureau of Air Quality (BAQ), Air Permitting Division

overview: SCDES (formerly SC DHEC's environmental programs) issues air construction permits before construction, alteration, or addition of a stationary source, and operating permits afterward, under S.C. Regulation 61-62.1 Section II. Lower tiers include construction permit exemptions (61-62.1 Section II(B) and the BAQ exemptions list), registration permits, and general permits (general construction, general state operating, and general conditional major operating permits) for sectors such as concrete plants, asphalt plants, nonmetallic mineral processing, and fuel combustion. Conditional major (synthetic minor) permits take limits to avoid PSD (61-62.1 Section II.E) and Title V (Section II.G). Title V is under Regulation 61-62.70. Non-Title V applications must be filed through ePermitting (paper not accepted after February 1, 2025). There are no local air agencies.

permitTypes.name: Construction permit exemptions
permitTypes.description: Source-specific exemptions (e.g., small boilers and space heaters, small gas-fired units, small emergency generators, comfort HVAC, lab hoods) and emission-level exemptions based on uncontrolled potential to emit. Exemption requests go through ePermitting and documentation is kept on site. Some exempt engines and boilers remain subject to NSPS IIII/JJJJ and NESHAP ZZZZ.
permitTypes.quote: PTE less than 5 tons per year [PM, PM10, PM2.5, SO2, NOx, CO] ... PTE less than 1000 pounds per month [VOC]
permitTypes.thresholds: Gas-fired units under 10 MMBtu/hr; emergency generators up to 150 kW (restated from SCDES).

permitTypes.name: Registration Permits (e.g., fuel combustion)
permitTypes.description: For true minor facilities with listed equipment. Fuel combustion registration covers boilers on natural gas, propane, virgin No. 2 oil, diesel, or biodiesel, with size limits for non-fuel-gas boilers, and non-emergency generators certified to EPA nonroad tiers with an hours limit for the modeling exemption.
permitTypes.thresholds: Boilers burning fuels other than natural gas or propane: 30 million Btu/hr heat input capacity for a single boiler and 100 million Btu/hr for all boilers on site combined. Non-emergency generators: no more than 500 hours per year, a condition of the exemption from modeling (restated from SCDES).

permitTypes.name: General Construction and General Operating Permits
permitTypes.description: General construction permits and general state or general conditional major operating permits for concrete plants (batch, block, pug mills), asphalt plants (general conditional major and general synthetic minor construction), nonmetallic mineral processing (general conditional major), and fuel combustion (general conditional major).
permitTypes.citation: S.C. Regulation 61-62.1, Section II(D) (general construction permits)
permitTypes.thresholds: Concrete plant fuel-burning devices under 30 MMBtu/hr (restated from SCDES).

permitTypes.name: Construction Permit (state and synthetic minor)
permitTypes.description: Required before construction, alteration, or addition of a stationary air pollution source; construction may not begin until it is issued. Synthetic minor construction permits set enforceable limits to avoid PSD and Title V.
permitTypes.citation: S.C. Regulation 61-62.1, Section II(A) and II(E) (synthetic minor)

permitTypes.name: Conditional Major Operating Permit
permitTypes.description: Operating permit with federally enforceable limits keeping the facility below PSD and Title V thresholds. Renewal under 61-62.1 Section II.H.
permitTypes.citation: S.C. Regulation 61-62.1, Section II(E) and II(G); renewals under II(H)
permitTypes.thresholds: General conditional major (fuel combustion): each criteria pollutant under 100 tpy, single HAP under 10 tpy, combined HAPs under 25 tpy (restated from SCDES).
permitTypes.quote: Any stationary source that satisfies the definition of a major source may request a federally enforceable conditional major operating permit to limit the source’s potential to emit and become a conditional major source.

quoteSource.name: S.C. Regulation 61-62.1, Definitions and General Requirements (SCDES)

permitTypes.name: Prevention of Significant Deterioration (PSD)
permitTypes.description: Major source construction permits in attainment areas, issued by SCDES. Standard No. 7 of Regulation 61-62.5 is listed in EPA's approved South Carolina SIP as Prevention of Significant Deterioration; conditional major permits cite 61-62.1 Section II(E) for PSD avoidance.

permitTypes.name: Nonattainment NSR
permitTypes.description: Major source nonattainment permits, issued by SCDES (per EPA). Standard No. 7.1 of Regulation 61-62.5 is listed in EPA's approved South Carolina SIP as Nonattainment New Source Review.

permitTypes.name: Title V Operating Permit
permitTypes.description: Operating permit for major sources under South Carolina's Part 70 program.
permitTypes.quote: A major source facility potentially emits 100 tons per year (TPY) or more of any criteria pollutant (CO, PM10, PM2.5, NOX, SO2, Pb, VOCs) and/or 10 TPY or more of any single hazardous air pollutant (HAP) or 25 TPY of combined HAPs.

oilAndGas.summary: South Carolina has no oil and gas production. SCDES's 'Oil & Natural Gas and Terminal Facility Registration' is a Bureau of Land & Waste Management program, not an air permit. Gasoline dispensing has its own BAQ page.
